**CustomAchievements 1.13.0** — for Paper 1.21.4 (Java 21). Drop the jar into
your server's `plugins/` folder. New config options are merged into your
existing `config.yml` automatically on first startup.

### Added

- **`ACHIEVEMENT_UNLOCK` — an achievement for earning achievements.** A capstone
  can require "unlock 20 achievements", or name a **category** as its target to
  count only that category ("unlock 20 in Mining"). Pick it from the trigger
  menu like any other; the target picker lists the categories you already use.

  The count is read from what the player has actually unlocked rather than
  tallied as it happens, so it can't drift: a capstone created today already
  credits everything earned before it existed, and revoking an achievement takes
  the count back down. Capstones stack — unlocking one is itself an unlock.

### Fixed

- **A version that learns to read a new statistic now reaches the players it was
  for.** An objective is marked as seeded even when the statistic comes back
  empty, which is what stops every join re-examining every unfinished objective
  forever. The cost was that 1.12.0's "add up every block" total never reached
  anyone who had already joined: their marker was set back when there was no
  answer to give, so the improvement was invisible to exactly the players it was
  written for.

  The marker now records which version of the reader set it. Gaining an answer
  re-examines every objective once, on the next join, with no admin action.
  Seeding only ever raises progress, so the retry can't cost anyone anything.

### Upgrading

Nothing to run. On each player's next join their block totals will be read and
credited — including on achievements that stayed stuck at 0 under 1.12.0.

`/ca backfill <player> redo` still exists for forcing a re-read at any time.
